title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
summary_full: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.
